g.text: One engine started by its own recipe
cmd: just engine-footprint | pass: the engine's recipe exits 0 ('retrieval-up', 'candle-up') after a MemAvailable check of at least 8 GiB
cmd: just engine-footprint | pass: the probe request (embeddings, rerank, chat) returns http 200
cmd: just engine-footprint | pass: a table row with 'container MiB' read from podman stats (n/a fails the run)
cmd: just engine-footprint | pass: prints 'PASS engine-footprint' and podman ps -a lists no wattson-embed, wattson-rerank or wattson-candle
